title: STRAWBERRY KIWI ICE – KUZ ULTRA 9000
description:
KUZ LUX 9000 PUFFS FOR ENDLESS ENJOYMENT
With up to 9000 puffs, the KUZ LUX 9000 promises enduring satisfaction, letting you savor every moment without the hassle of constant refills.

OTHER FLAVOURS:
– Aloe Grape
– Apple Burst
– Blackberry Ice
– Blueberry Blast
– Blueberry Raspberry
– Cherry Cola
– Cool Coconut Ice
– Fruit Candy
– Kiwi Dragon Fruit
– Orange Fanta Soda
– Peach Pineapple
– Strawberry Coconut Watermelon
– Strawberry Kiwi Ice
– Strawberry Raspberry
– Watermelon Raspberry

STUNNING 3D AESTHETIC DYNAMIC SCREEN
Featuring a striking 3D dynamic screen, the KUZ LUX 9000 offers not only essential
information but also a visually captivating display that elevates your vaping experience.

0.8Ω DUAL MESH COIL FOR RICH, SMOOTH FLAVOR
Experience deep, velvety flavor and thick vapor with the 0.8Ω dual mesh coil, meticulously designed to enhance every single puff.

360°SUPER FEEL FOR MAXIMUM COMFORT
Crafted with a 360° super feel process, the KUZ LUX 9000 fits seamlessly into your hand, providing an ergonomic, luxurious grip for ultimate comfort during every use.

FEATURES
– UP TO 9000 PUFFS
– 0.8Ω DUAL MESH COIL
– 2500 mAh
